parameter_source: Prior-only, no fit or result-driven parameter selection. Frozen before Train/Dev matching or related metrics.

model.batch: one batch per query, no cross-query cache
model.worker_error_policy: terminate worker, remain degraded until app process restart

policy.text: Existing matcher fields in listed order. Strip each populated field, join with one space, strip outer whitespace and truncate to max_chars_per_side.
policy.eligible: Legacy profile only and only with previous ranking and automatic acceptance experiments inactive. Skip the whole pool on exact_code. Restrict movement to contiguous live, uncapped, positive, finite, non-blocked prefix of frozen Top-20. Stop at hard conflict, expired/inactive code, protection for safety unknown or disagreement including unit ratio, or explicitly requested unverified field. Need at least two eligible scores with nonzero score range.
policy.fusion: stable descending clip(base_score + 3 * (2 * sigmoid(logit) - 1), original eligible minimum, original eligible maximum)
policy.evidence: Replay original M0 evidence function on final full pool. Existing M0 stale-evidence and M2 authority checks continue to apply.

inputs.heldout_policy: Original gold and governance fixtures forbidden for opening. Use pre-existing Train/Dev-only materialized inputs and build/verify projected labels from independent frozen evidence.

evaluation.comparison: Same staged V017 catalog/config/index and M2 implementation, separate serial fresh processes, ordered replay with original IDs paired. No changes based on Dev.
evaluation.ranking_cohort: V017 legacy core and governance answerable, non-blocked ranks; strict original target, equivalent approved alternative.
evaluation.paired_ci: 95% deterministic percentile paired bootstrap (10000 replicates, seed 210301); paired wins/ties/losses by metric.
evaluation.binding_ci: Wilson 95%, null for zero adjudicable denominator. A tier counts at all rows; correctness uses adjudicable core answerable/explicit negatives and confirmed equivalent codes. Error automatic binding uses upload decision_status auto_accepted on adjudicable core, tracks unknown independently.
evaluation.domain_floor: Apply signed V017 cohort floors at corresponding rates on each domain cohort with n>=20 and require same-mode paired non-regression in Recall@100/200 and equivalent Hit@1; report all nine including cohorts below 20.
evaluation.performance: Five single plus one five-row upload warmups, ranking pass, 1060 real single route calls, 21 complete 50-row upload route calls plus 10-row tail excluded from upload quantiles. Nearest rank. Sample combined parent and model worker RSS across phases, report Windows per-process peak working set and combined maximum simultaneous working set.
evaluation.selection: Both ranking metrics Hit@1 and MRR@10 and A coverage strictly increase on Dev, A precision does not decrease and is adjudicable, zero erroneous auto bindings on frozen Train/Dev, protected probes and domain floors and all signed resource budgets pass. Candidate selection only, default OFF.
